entities.name: NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Provides transport of payload between the UE and the AMF. The payload type is identified by the Payload container type IE and can include various message types and containers.

entities.name: Payload container type IE
entities.description: Identifies the type of payload being transported in the NAS transport procedure. Includes various payload types such as 5GSM messages, LPP messages, and other containers.

entities.name: Payload container IE
entities.description: Contains the actual payload and optional associated information. For multiple payloads, it consists of a list of payload container entries.

entities.name: Multiple payloads type
entities.description: Payload type set to 'Multiple payloads' when more than one payload needs to be transported using NAS transport procedures.

entities.name: Payload container entry
entities.description: Individual entry within the Payload container IE when multiple payloads are transported. Contains payload and optional associated information.

relations.description: NAS transport procedure uses the Payload container type IE to identify the type of payload being transported.
NAS transport procedure carries the Payload container IE which contains the actual payload and optional associated information.
Payload container type IE can be set to 'Multiple payloads' condition when multiple payloads need transport.
Payload container IE contains payload container entries when multiple payloads are transported.
